turns.text: Hello, I moved today and need to update the delivery address for my order.
Hello, I can help with that. Please send me your order number (it looks like SC-1007) and the email address the order was placed with. I will check the details once I have both.
The order number is SC-4040 and my email is george.miller.v2@example.com. New address is Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara.

Thank you, George. I checked order SC-4040. It has already shipped, and our policy allows delivery address changes only before an order ships, so I can't change the address for this order. You can follow the delivery with the tracking link: https://curier.example/track/SC4040. If you need help with the delivery itself, let me know.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.
